heading: Something needs you
stepBody: An interactive step of the runtime {{name}} waits for you: a command you run yourself in a terminal on the node (for example one that asks for a sudo password).
restartBody: The runtime {{name}} stopped. Its start is one you run yourself, so WS Model Proxy does not restart it on its own: restart it when you are ready.
markStoppedBody: An instance of the runtime {{name}} lost touch with its node, and WS Model Proxy cannot prove it stopped. When you know it is down, choose Mark as stopped on the runtime page.
queuedCommandSubject: An agent queued a command for you on {{name}}
queuedCommandBody: An agent queued a command for you to run on the node {{name}}. Review it in Terminals, then run it or dismiss it.
footer: You get this email because operational alerts are on in your settings. Agents cannot answer these for you.
